about: WRITING-FORMATS-03: skeleton rows for the writing_format tool (bench_row writing-format). label W = a brief to write an email or a birthday card (writing_format expected); N = anything else, writing-adjacent or not (writing_format must not be called). SKELETON ONLY: the 10 fixed quality briefs and the CHAT-AB-01 held-out split rows are still to be added before the row is measured (3 or more repeats, paired 95% intervals, rule 13). Unrun. Persona names only.
